sources.snippet: RAWmakase /raw·muh·KAH·say/, RAW + omakase The Lightroom-compatible RAW editor. Free, open source and fast. RAWmakase is a free RAW photo editor for macOS, Linux and Windows, with no subscription and no lock-in. Bring your Lightroom Classic catalog, presets and camera profiles, keep editing with the Library and Develop controls you already know, and let the GPU keep up with you.
